docs.text: I love most of this ... but I found Lake Erie fish rather bland. Maybe that's because I was on the Ohio side of the lake. Certainly, any experience in Canada is better than the same in Ohio, so I'll reserve that judgement based on lack of true experience. *starts looking up Canadian fish recipes*
You could not pay me to eat fish out of lake Ontario. Halifax has incredible seafood though!
I live on Lake Erie and I remember this threat. This will be disastrous for the commercial fishing and sport fishing industry😭
the fishing in Jacksonville is probably a little better than Lake Erie, with all due respect
Politely, of course :) And it's easier to get food from humans than fishing in Lake Erie!
Lake Erie, because of how shallow and warm it is, produces more commercial fish than the other 4 lakes combined.

Also, because you can't travel in southern Ontario without tripping over one of the Great Lakes, there will be a variety of fish. We may return with luggage containing nothing but cheese, cider, and smoked fish.

It's one of the most boring lakes of the great lakes. Only Lake Erie is more pathetic, and it doesn't border Michigan, and is basically a liquid landfill for Ohio anyway. Huron is pretty undramatic. I am told the fishing is better, but that is if invasive zebra mussels have left anything alive.
I've gotten seasick on less intense stuff on Lake Erie (probably Force 2-3) fishing before. I'd surely be needing the puke bucket at Force 8.
Lake Erie is a natural destination for fishing. Locally? The waterways need a little booster shot. Here's how that happens.

Now a nice perch or a bass out of the lakes more northern ontario, or even central like Parry Sound, you’re gucci, but nah there’s a reason we get most our fish in southern ontario shipped in frozen lol Lake Ontario, Superior and Huron are transit lakes! Horrible harbor and factory run offs, yucky
I regularly fish Lake Erie and Lake Ontario and it’s definitely been in the back of my mind. We stay on the 🇨🇦side, far from the border but these days it feels more and more risky to go out.
Ready to cast a line? ODNR has announced the best lakes, rivers and streams for fishing in Ohio. And none of them are Lake Erie. Here's the full list.
